mode_rationale: Source describes infrastructure additions (optional dep, new build target, new platform) with no failure/negation language.

queries.intent: Locate every uvloop reference (code, build config, docs)
Inspect declared dependencies, python_requires, classifiers, package-data
Inspect Cython extension build flags for Windows/MSVC portability
Inspect release workflow: OS matrix, Python matrix, cibuildwheel config
Find where an asyncio event loop is created/configured (candidate site for uvloop auto-use)
Check how the Rust extension is loaded and whether it degrades gracefully (Windows fallback)
Inspect Rust workspace + maturin config (PyO3 version for 3.14, platform cfg)
Read the prior uv + Python 3.14 migration plan to avoid duplicating scope
State of the migrate-uv-python314 worktree/branch relative to main
Resolved versions of build-critical deps in uv.lock (Cython/uvloop/numpy for 3.14 support)
Test suite event loop usage and pytest config (asyncio mode, warnings)
Existing platform-conditional code (sys.platform/os.name/win32) and C++ stdlib usage in .pyx
CI surface: other workflows, tox config, Makefile targets
User-facing docs mentioning uvloop, Windows, install instructions
